title: FactsFile
description: Per-device network facts extracted from SAOS 6 / 8 / 10 configurations (saos-network-facts). Schema 1.x: minor versions only add optional fields, so a reader must ignore fields it does not know.

schema_version.description: The schema version the file follows (semver; this schema is 1.x).

devices.description: One record per device, in input order.

links.description: Physical links between devices, as the input topology declares them (the `links` of a containerlab file given with `--clab`), in topology order. Optional: present only when the extractor was given a topology; absent in files before schema 1.4. Since schema 1.5.

hosts.description: Linux hosts of the lab (test hosts, DCN gateways, CEs that are Linux containers): their addresses, routes and the device ports they are cabled to. From the `linux` nodes of a containerlab file given with `--clab` (their `exec` lines) and from a hosts file given with `--hosts`. A host has no device facts; a containerlab host also keeps its `devices[]` record (`status: skipped`). Optional: present (possibly empty) only when the extractor was given a topology or a hosts file; absent in files before schema 1.8. Since schema 1.8.

translator.description: The SAOS 10 translator used, as `translator <version> (<backend>)`; null when none was needed or used.

name.description: The host name: the containerlab node or the hosts-file key (a containerlab host's `devices[].device` too).

kind.description: The containerlab kind (`linux`); null for a host only the hosts file gives without one.

sources.description: Where the host comes from: `clab` (a containerlab node and its `exec` lines), `hosts-file` (`--hosts`), in that order; a hosts-file entry for a containerlab host is merged into it.

interfaces.description: The host's interfaces: those it is cabled on in the topology (in link order), then those only an address names.

routes.description: The host's static routes (`ip route add|replace`, the hosts file's `routes` and `gateway`), one per prefix, in the order given (a later route to the same prefix replaces the earlier one).

ignored_commands.description: The containerlab `exec` commands the extractor did not read, as written: anything but `ip addr add` and `ip route add|replace` (`ip link set ... up`, `sysctl`, a script), so nothing is dropped silently.

HostGateway.title: HostGateway
HostGateway.description: A host's default gateway per address family: the next hop of its default route (`0.0.0.0/0`, `::/0`) with the lowest metric. Since schema 1.8.

ipv4.description: The IPv4 default gateway; null when the host has no IPv4 default route.

ipv6.description: The IPv6 default gateway; null when the host has no IPv6 default route.

HostInterface.title: HostInterface
HostInterface.description: An interface of a Linux host. Since schema 1.8.

name.description: The interface name (`eth1`), as the topology's link and `ip addr add ... dev` name it.

addresses.description: Its addresses with prefix length (`192.168.10.10/24`, `2001:db8:10::10/64`), IPv4 and IPv6, in the order configured; an address given without a length is a host address (/32, /128).

attached.description: The device and port at the other end of the cable (from the topology's `links`, or the hosts file's `attached`); null when not cabled in the inputs.

HostRoute.title: HostRoute
HostRoute.description: A static route of a Linux host. Since schema 1.8.

next_hop.description: The next-hop address (`via`); null for a route out of an interface alone.

interface.description: The outgoing interface (`dev`); null when not given.

metric.description: The route metric; null when not given (the kernel's 0).

FailedTemplate.title: FailedTemplate
FailedTemplate.description: A configuration file the SAOS 10 translator could not parse.

DeviceRecord.title: DeviceRecord
DeviceRecord.description: One device: where its facts came from, whether extraction worked, and the facts.

recipe.description: Optional label for the lab / recipe / design the device belongs to (`extract --recipe`).

device.description: The device name: the containerlab node, the platform-map key, or the configuration file name up to its first dot.

type.description: The device type as given by the inputs (`5164-10x`, `3930-6x`, a containerlab `type` such as `5164`); null when unknown.

platform.description: SAOS 10 only: the translator platform the files were parsed for (`cn5164`).

extractor.description: `saos6` (SAOS 6 and SAOS 8 CLI, parsed directly), `saos10` (CLI or NETCONF XML through the translator's pivot JSON), or null when no extractor applies.

templates.description: The device's configuration files, in the order they were applied (relative to the configs directory or the clab file).

status.description: `ok`: every file was read. `partial`: some SAOS 10 files failed (see `failed_templates`); `facts` holds the rest. `error`: nothing could be read. `skipped`: no extractor, no configuration, or no translator (`--no-saos10`); see `reason`.

facts.description: The device's facts; null when `status` is `error` or `skipped`.

failed_templates.description: `partial` / `error` SAOS 10 devices: the files the translator refused.

Interface.title: Interface
Interface.description: A layer-3 interface: loopback, IP interface, management interface (SAOS 6), or any SAOS 10 openconfig interface that is not a physical port.

name.description: The interface name (`remote` / `local` for the SAOS 6 management interfaces).

kind.description: SAOS 6: `loopback`, `ip` or `management`. SAOS 10: the interface type as configured (`loopback`, `ip`, `lag`, `point-to-point`, ...; `system` is the management bridge, mgmtbr0). Management interfaces (`management`, `system`) address the management network, not a link between devices.

ip.description: The (first IPv4) address with its prefix length, as written (`192.0.2.1/32`).

vlan.description: SAOS 6: the VLAN the IP interface sits on. Null on SAOS 10 (see `fd`).

vs.description: SAOS 6: the virtual switch the IP interface sits on.

fd.description: SAOS 10: the forwarding domain the interface is bound to (underlay binding); a flow point on the same fd ties it to a port.

vrf.description: SAOS 10: the VRF the interface is in (`vrfName`, see `vrf_instances`); null for the default VRF.

isis.description: SAOS 10: the IS-IS instance the interface is attached to.

Transmitter.title: Transmitter
Transmitter.description: SAOS 10: the optical transmitter configured on a port (`ptps`).

Port.title: Port
Port.description: A physical port, LAG or SAOS 10 logical port, keyed by its name.

vlans.description: VLANs the port carries: SAOS 6 VLAN membership; SAOS 10 the VLANs of the classifiers on the flow points that use the port.

lag.description: The LAG the port is a member of.

ptp_id.description: SAOS 10: the ettp interface's PTP id.

port_speed.description: SAOS 10: the ettp interface's port speed.

auto_negotiation.description: SAOS 10: the ettp interface's auto-negotiation setting.

Vlan.title: Vlan
Vlan.description: A VLAN and the ports that carry it.

Ring.title: Ring
Ring.description: A G.8032 ring on this device: a SAOS 6 / 8 logical ring (`ring-protection logical-ring`) or a SAOS 10 `g8032-ring`. `name`, `west` and `east` are the schema 1.0 fields; the rest are optional and absent in files before schema 1.4.

name.description: The ring name (SAOS 6 / 8 logical ring name, SAOS 10 ring name).

west.description: The west ring port: SAOS 6 / 8 `west-port`; SAOS 10 the interface of ring port `port0`.

east.description: The east ring port: SAOS 6 / 8 `east-port`; SAOS 10 the interface of ring port `port1`.

ring_id.description: The G.8032 ring id (`ring-id`), as written; null when not configured. Since schema 1.5.

ports.description: The ring ports as configured, in configuration order: SAOS 6 / 8 `west` and `east`, SAOS 10 `port0` and `port1`. Since schema 1.5.

instances.description: The Ethernet ring protection instances on the ring (SAOS 10 `erp-instance`, SAOS 6 / 8 virtual ring), in configuration order; empty when the configuration creates none. Since schema 1.5.

RingPort.title: RingPort
RingPort.description: One of a ring's two ports. Values are text, as written. Since schema 1.5.

name.description: The ring port's name in the configuration: SAOS 6 / 8 `west` / `east`, SAOS 10 `port0` / `port1`.

interface.description: The port or interface the ring port is on (a port, a LAG, or a SAOS 10 logical port); null when the configuration does not say.

hold_off.description: SAOS 6 / 8: the port's hold-off time in milliseconds (`west-port-holdoff-time` / `east-port-holdoff-time`), as configured; null when not configured. Always null on SAOS 10, whose hold-off is per instance (`RingTimers.hold_off`).

RplPort.title: RplPort
RplPort.description: The ring protection link (RPL) role configured on one ring port of an instance. Since schema 1.5.

interface.description: The port or interface of that ring port (`Ring.ports[].interface`), for convenience; null when unknown.

role.description: The configured RPL role: `owner` (this port is the RPL and blocks in the idle state), `neighbor` (the other end of the RPL), `next-neighbor`, or `none` (written explicitly, as SAOS 10 `rpl none`). A port the configuration says nothing about has no entry.

RingTimers.title: RingTimers
RingTimers.description: The protection timers of an instance, as configured; null when the configuration does not set one (the device uses its default). Values are text, as written. Since schema 1.5.

wtr.description: Wait-to-restore time in minutes (SAOS 10 `wtr-timer`; SAOS 6 / 8 `wtr` on the logical ring, reported on each of its instances).

guard.description: Guard time in milliseconds (SAOS 10 `guard-timer`; SAOS 6 / 8 `guard-time` on the logical ring, reported on each of its instances).

hold_off.description: SAOS 10: hold-off time in milliseconds (`hold-off-time`). Always null on SAOS 6 / 8, whose hold-off is per ring port (`RingPort.hold_off`).

RingInstance.title: RingInstance
RingInstance.description: An Ethernet ring protection (ERP) instance on a ring: a SAOS 10 `erp-instance` or a SAOS 6 / 8 virtual ring (`ring-protection virtual-ring`). Values are as configured: nothing is filled in from defaults, and null means the configuration does not say. Since schema 1.5.

name.description: The instance name (SAOS 10 `erp-instance` name, SAOS 6 / 8 virtual ring name).

raps_vid.description: The VLAN id of the R-APS control channel (`raps-vid`), as written.

raps_level.description: The maintenance entity group (MEG / MD) level of the R-APS messages (SAOS 10 `raps-level`, SAOS 6 / 8 `mel`), as written; null when not configured.

type.description: `major` for a major ring instance, `sub` for a sub-ring instance (SAOS 10 `erp-instance-construct`; SAOS 6 / 8 `sub-ring` on the virtual ring, else major); null when the configuration does not say.

virtual_channel.description: For a sub-ring, whether its R-APS channel is carried over the major ring (SAOS 10 `sub-ring-virtual-channel` true, `sub-ring-no-virtual-channel` false). Null for a major ring and on SAOS 6 / 8, where the configuration does not say.

termination.description: SAOS 6 / 8 sub-rings: the ring port the sub-ring terminates on at this node (`sub-ring west-port-termination` / `east-port-termination`), or `none` (`no-port-termination`: the sub-ring passes through this node). Null for a major ring and on SAOS 10, which has no such leaf (a terminating node lists one port in `rpl`).

sub_ring_of.description: Derived: for a sub-ring instance on an interconnection node, the name of the other ring on this device that shares one of this ring's ports (the ring the sub-ring is attached to). Null on a node where the sub-ring passes through, and for a major ring.

rpl.description: The RPL role configured per ring port, in configuration order (SAOS 10 `ports port <id> rpl <role>`; SAOS 6 / 8 `west-port-rpl owner` / `east-port-rpl owner`). Empty when the configuration sets none.

members.description: What the instance protects, as named in the configuration: SAOS 10 forwarding domains (`data-members`), SAOS 6 VLAN ids (`virtual-ring add ... vid`), SAOS 8 virtual switches (`virtual-ring add ... vs`).

revertive.description: Whether the instance reverts to the RPL after a failure clears (SAOS 10 `reversion revertive` / `non-revertive`, SAOS 6 / 8 `revertive on` / `off`); null when not configured (the device default).

Peer.title: Peer
Peer.description: A remote end the device is configured to talk to.

kind.description: `mpls-vc` (SAOS 6 static VC), `tp-tunnel` (SAOS 6 MPLS-TP tunnel end) or `bgp` (SAOS 10 BGP neighbour).

name.description: The VC or tunnel name; for `bgp` the local AS as `as<N>`.

route_reflector_client.description: `bgp`: the neighbour is a route-reflector client of this device in at least one address family.

address_families.description: `bgp`: the neighbour's address families, `<afi> <safi>` (`vpnv4 unicast`, `l2vpn evpn`).

peer_group.description: `bgp` (SAOS 10): the peer group the neighbour is configured in (`peer <ip> peer-group <name>`); null when none. Optional: absent in files before schema 1.6. Since schema 1.6.

vrf.description: `bgp` (SAOS 10): the VRF the neighbour is configured in (`bgp instance <as> vrf <name> vrf-address-family <afi> <safi> peer <address>`, a CE neighbour of an L3VPN, see `vrf_instances`); null for a neighbour of the global table. A VRF neighbour has no peer group; its `address_families` are the VRF address families it is configured in. Optional: absent in files before schema 1.7. Since schema 1.7.

level.description: The level as written: SAOS 6 `L1` / `L2` / `L1L2`, SAOS 10 `level-1` / `level-2` / `level-1-2`.

area.description: Kept for compatibility, as written: SAOS 6 the area (`49.0011`), SAOS 10 the first NET. Use `area_id` and `net`.

nets.description: Every NET configured on the instance.

area_id.description: The area: the NET without its system id and NSEL (`49.0001`); SAOS 6 the configured area when no NET is set.

system_id.description: The system id part of the NET (`1920.0000.2001`).

sr_enabled.description: SAOS 10: segment routing is enabled on the instance; null when not configured.

address_families.description: SAOS 10: the address families the instance runs, the union over its interfaces (`ipv4 unicast`, `ipv6 unicast`): IPv4 unicast runs on an interface unless `ipv4-unicast-default-disable`, IPv6 unicast where `address-family ipv6 unicast` is configured. An IPv6-only IGP lists only `ipv6 unicast`. Optional: absent in files before schema 1.6. Since schema 1.6.

multi_topology.description: SAOS 10: multi-topology routing (RFC 5120, IPv6 in its own topology) is on: `multi-topology-mode enable` or the deprecated `multi-topology <level>`; null when not configured (single topology). Optional: absent in files before schema 1.6. Since schema 1.6.

srv6_enabled.description: SAOS 10: the instance advertises at least one SRv6 locator (see `srv6_locators`). Optional: absent in files before schema 1.6. Since schema 1.6.

srv6_locators.description: SAOS 10: names of the SRv6 locators (`segment_routing.srv6.locators`) the instance advertises: those whose `instances` name it, and those that name no instance (advertised in every instance). Optional: absent in files before schema 1.6. Since schema 1.6.

IsisInterface.title: IsisInterface
IsisInterface.description: An interface attached to an IS-IS instance.

level.description: The interface's level, as written; null when it follows the instance.

type.description: The interface type (`point-to-point`, `broadcast`); null when not configured.

metrics.description: The metrics configured on the interface, one entry per level in configuration order (SAOS 10 `level-1` / `level-2` `metric` and `wide-metric`; SAOS 6 / 8 `isis interface-level set ... level L1|L2 wide-metric`). An empty list when the configuration sets no metric (the interface advertises its default). Optional: absent in files before schema 1.3. Since schema 1.3.

address_families.description: SAOS 10: the address families the interface runs: `ipv4 unicast` unless `ipv4-unicast-default-disable true`, then each configured `address-families address-family <afi> <safi>` (`ipv6 unicast`). Optional: absent in files before schema 1.6. Since schema 1.6.

IsisMetric.title: IsisMetric
IsisMetric.description: The metric an IS-IS interface advertises at one level. Values are text, as written. Since schema 1.3.

level.description: The level, in the configuration's own spelling: SAOS 10 `level-1` / `level-2`, SAOS 6 / 8 `L1` / `L2`.

metric.description: SAOS 10: the narrow (ISO 10589, 6-bit) metric of the level; null when not configured, and always null on SAOS 6 / 8, which have no narrow metric.

wide_metric.description: The wide (RFC 5305, 24-bit) metric of the level; null when not configured.

instance.description: The IS-IS instance that sets it.

interface.description: The interface the prefix is on.

sid.description: The SID value, as written: an index into the SRGB or an absolute label, per `value_type`.

node.description: A node SID: a host prefix (/32, /128) on a loopback.

CandidatePath.title: CandidatePath
CandidatePath.description: A candidate path of an SR policy.

preference.description: Preference; the highest valid path is active.

segment_lists.description: Names of the explicit segment lists (see `segment_lists`).

SrPolicy.title: SrPolicy
SrPolicy.description: An SR-TE policy, keyed by color and endpoint.

SegmentRouting.title: SegmentRouting
SegmentRouting.description: Segment routing (SR-MPLS / SRv6). SAOS 10 only; empty on SAOS 6 / 8.

srgb.description: SRGBs, one per IS-IS instance that sets one.

segment_lists.description: Explicit segment lists by name: the SIDs (labels or SRv6 SIDs) in order.

srv6.description: SAOS 10: SRv6 locators. Optional: absent in files before schema 1.6. Since schema 1.6.

flex_algorithms.description: SAOS 10: Flex-Algo definitions, in configuration order. Optional: absent in files before schema 1.6. Since schema 1.6.

cluster_id.description: Route-reflector cluster id; null when not set.

route_reflector.description: The device reflects routes: at least one neighbour of the instance is a route-reflector client.

srv6_locator.description: The SRv6 locator the instance allocates its service SIDs from (`segment-routing srv6 locator`); null when not set. An address family's locator (`srv6_locators`) and a VRF address family's own win over it. Optional: absent in files before schema 1.7. Since schema 1.7.

srv6_locators.description: The SRv6 locator per address family of the instance (`address-family <afi> <safi> segment-routing-srv6 locator`), by `<afi> <safi>` (`vpnv4 unicast`, `vpnv6 unicast`); empty when none. Optional: absent in files before schema 1.7. Since schema 1.7.

Bgp.title: Bgp
Bgp.description: BGP instances; the neighbours are `peers` of kind `bgp`.

Pseudowire.title: Pseudowire
Pseudowire.description: A pseudowire (VPWS / VPLS spoke or mesh PW).

tunnel.description: The tunnel the PW rides on, when configured (MPLS-TP tunnel name).

tunnel_type.description: SAOS 10: the transport the PW is steered onto, as configured (`sr-policy`, `rsvp-te`, ...); null when not configured (the device resolves the peer address over its default transport: the peer's Prefix-SID or LDP LSP). Since schema 1.1.

tunnel_color.description: SAOS 10: with `tunnel_type` `sr-policy`, the color of the SR policy to the peer that carries the PW. Since schema 1.1.

service.description: The service carrying the PW: SAOS 6 the virtual switch it is attached to, SAOS 10 the l2vpn service.

service_type.description: SAOS 10: `vpws` or `vpls`, from the mode of the service's forwarding domain; null when unknown.

Mep.title: Mep
Mep.description: A CFM maintenance-association end point on this device.

md.description: Maintenance domain (SAOS 10 MD id; null on SAOS 6, where the MA carries the level).

ma.description: Maintenance association (SAOS 10 MA id, SAOS 6 CFM service name).

interface.description: SAOS 10: the flow point the MEP sits on; SAOS 6: the sub-port, when it is on one.

port.description: The port the MEP sits on (SAOS 10: the flow point's logical port).

vlan.description: The VLAN of the MEP (SAOS 10: from the flow point's classifier).

service.description: SAOS 10: the MA's forwarding domain; SAOS 6: the CFM service's virtual switch.

ccm_interval.description: The CCM interval of the MEP's maintenance association as written (since schema 1.4): SAOS 10 `ccm-interval` (`3.3ms`, `10ms`, `100ms`, `1s`, `10s`, `1min`, `10min`); SAOS 6 `cfm service set ... ccm-interval` (`3.33ms`, `1sec`, `10sec`, `1min`, ..., `off`, or the 802.1Q interval index `0`-`7`). Null when not configured (the device default, 1 s).

Fp.title: FlowPoint
Fp.description: SAOS 10 flow point: a logical port's attachment to a forwarding domain.

classifiers.description: Classifiers that select the flow point's frames (see `classifiers`).

port.description: Logical port (a LAG or a port).

Facts.title: DeviceFacts
Facts.description: What the device's configuration says. Every value read from a configuration is text, as written; flags derived by the extractor are booleans. The SAOS 10 fields are absent on SAOS 6 / 8 devices.

rings.description: G.8032 rings configured on the device (SAOS 6 / 8 logical rings, SAOS 10 `g8032-ring`s), with their protection instances since schema 1.5.

peers.description: MPLS VCs, MPLS-TP tunnel ends and BGP neighbours.

lines.description: SAOS 6: command lines seen. SAOS 10: top-level YANG objects seen (same as `objects`).

recognised.description: Lines (SAOS 6) or top-level objects (SAOS 10) that produced a fact.

classifiers.description: SAOS 10 classifiers by name: the VLAN ids they match.

vrfs.description: SAOS 10 VRF names (the `vrf` list). Since schema 1.7 `vrf_instances` carries each VRF's settings.

objects.description: SAOS 10: top-level YANG objects seen across the device's files.

tp_corouted_tunnels.description: SAOS 10 MPLS-TP co-routed tunnels, one entry per tunnel this node is on. Since schema 1.2.

evpn_instances.description: SAOS 10 EVPN instances (EVPN-VPLS, EVPN-VPWS, FXC). Optional: absent in files before schema 1.6. Since schema 1.6.

vrf_instances.description: SAOS 10 VRFs (L3VPN / VRF-Lite / management VRFs) with their route distinguisher, route targets, address families, SRv6 locators and bound interfaces: the VRFs the `vrf` list defines, then any that only BGP names. Optional: absent in files before schema 1.7. Since schema 1.7.

static_routes.description: SAOS 10 static routes (`rib vrf <name> ipv4|ipv6 <prefix>`), one entry per next hop, in configuration order; `vrf` is `default` for the global table. Optional: absent in files before schema 1.7. Since schema 1.7.

OspfArea.title: OspfArea
OspfArea.description: An OSPF area of an instance.

area.description: The area id, dotted (`0.0.0.0` is the backbone).

type.description: Area type when configured (`stub`, `nssa`); null for a normal area.

networks.description: The prefixes whose interfaces are in the area, as configured (`network`).

router_id.description: Router id; null when not configured (the device picks one).

vrf.description: The VRF the instance runs in; null when not configured (the default VRF).

OspfInterface.title: OspfInterface
OspfInterface.description: An interface an OSPF instance runs on (SAOS 10). Since schema 1.2.

area.description: The area: the area of the instance whose `networks` cover the interface's address (derived); null when none does.

type.description: Network type (`point-to-point`, `broadcast`); null when not configured.

metric.description: Interface cost; null when not configured.

hello_interval.description: Hello interval in seconds; null when not configured.

dead_interval.description: Dead interval in seconds; null when not configured.

priority.description: DR election priority; null when not configured.

passive.description: No adjacency is formed: configured `passive`, or the interface is a loopback (advertised as a stub network).

bfd.description: BFD is enabled on the interface.

interfaces.description: Interfaces per instance, in configuration order.

TpTunnelBfd.title: TpTunnelBfd
TpTunnelBfd.description: LSP BFD (proactive OAM) on an MPLS-TP tunnel.

interval_ms.description: Desired minimum transmit interval in milliseconds (derived: SAOS 10 configures microseconds); null when not configured.

TpTunnelRef.title: TpTunnelRef
TpTunnelRef.description: The primary tunnel a backup tunnel protects.

TpCoroutedTunnel.title: TpCoroutedTunnel
TpCoroutedTunnel.description: One node's segment of a static MPLS-TP co-routed (bidirectional) tunnel (SAOS 10 `ciena-mpls-tp-corouted`). Every node on the path configures the tunnel under the same name, source and destination: the ingress its forward-out and reverse-in labels, a transit node all four, the egress forward-in and reverse-out. Labels are null where the node's role has none. Since schema 1.2.

type.description: This node's role in the tunnel: `static-ingress-corouted`, `static-transit-corouted` or `static-egress-corouted`.

primary.description: A backup tunnel: the primary it protects; null otherwise.

reversion.description: Reversion to the primary after a protection switch, `enable` or `disable`; `enable` when not configured.

reversion_hold_time.description: Reversion hold time in seconds; null when not configured.

forward_in_label.description: Label received in the forward direction (transit, egress).

forward_out_label.description: Label sent in the forward direction (ingress, transit).

reverse_in_label.description: Label received in the reverse direction (ingress, transit).

reverse_out_label.description: Label sent in the reverse direction (transit, egress).

prev_hop_ip.description: Reverse-direction next hop: the previous node of the forward path (transit, egress).

bfd.description: LSP BFD parameters; null when not configured.

L2vpnService.title: L2vpnService
L2vpnService.description: A SAOS 10 L2VPN service (`ciena-l2vpn`): binds a forwarding domain to pseudowires. Since schema 1.2.

fd.description: The forwarding domain carrying the attachment circuits.

mtu.description: Service MTU; null when not configured.

LinkEnd.title: LinkEnd
LinkEnd.description: One end of a physical link. Since schema 1.5.

port.description: The port on that device, as the topology names it (`2`, `eth1`).

Link.title: Link
Link.description: A physical link between two device ports, as the input topology declares it. Since schema 1.5.

Srv6Locator.title: Srv6Locator
Srv6Locator.description: An SRv6 locator (`segment-routing srv6 locators locator`): the IPv6 prefix the node's SRv6 SIDs are allocated from. Since schema 1.6.

name.description: Locator name (what EVPN instances and IS-IS refer to).

sid_type.description: The SID format: `u-sid` (compressed micro-SIDs) or `uncompressed-sid`; null when not configured.

algorithm.description: The Flex-Algo (128-255) the locator belongs to (see `flex_algorithms`); null for algorithm 0 (SPF).

block_length.description: Length in bits of the SID locator block; null when not configured.

node_length.description: Length in bits of the SID node part; null when not configured.

function_length.description: Length in bits of the SID function part; null when not configured.

end_behavior.description: The End behavior type as written (`End.PSP_USD`, `End_NEXT_CSID_PSP_USD`); null when not configured.

instances.description: IS-IS instances the locator is restricted to (`instances instance`); empty when every instance advertises it.

AdminGroups.title: FlexAlgoAdminGroups
AdminGroups.description: The link affinities (admin groups, by name) a Flex-Algo computation uses. Since schema 1.6.

include_any.description: A link is used only if it has at least one of these groups (`include-any-admin-group`).

include_all.description: A link is used only if it has all of these groups (`include-all-admin-group`).

exclude_any.description: A link with any of these groups is not used (`exclude-any-admin-group`).

FlexAlgorithm.title: FlexAlgorithm
FlexAlgorithm.description: A Flex-Algo definition (`segment-routing flex-algorithm`, RFC 9350). Since schema 1.6.

metric_type.description: The metric the computation minimises: `igp`, `latency` or `te`; null when not configured (IGP).

advertise_definition.description: This node advertises the definition (`advertise-definition`); otherwise it only takes part in the algorithm and follows the highest-priority definition in the area.

priority.description: The advertised definition's priority (0-255, highest wins); null when not configured.

srlg_exclude.description: Shared risk link groups excluded from the computation (`srlg-exclude`).

RouteTarget.title: RouteTarget
RouteTarget.description: A route target of an EVPN instance (`vpn-target`). Since schema 1.6.

EvpnInstance.title: EvpnInstance
EvpnInstance.description: A SAOS 10 EVPN instance (`evpn evpn-instances evpn-instance`): binds a forwarding domain to the EVPN control plane. Since schema 1.6.

type.description: The service: `vpls` (EVPN-VPLS, `vpls-fd`), `vpws` (EVPN-VPWS, `vpws-cross-connect-fd`) or `fxc` (VLAN-aware flexible cross-connect); null when no forwarding domain is bound.

fd.description: The forwarding domain (see `fds`); the first one when the instance binds several.

fds.description: Every forwarding domain the instance binds, in configuration order.

local_service_id.description: EVPN-VPWS: the service id of the local attachment circuit; the remote end configures it as its `remote_service_id`.

remote_service_id.description: EVPN-VPWS: the service id of the remote end.

control_word.description: The control word setting of the forwarding domain binding; null when not configured (the default is on).

route_distinguisher.description: The route distinguisher (`192.0.2.1:100`); null when not configured (auto).

srv6_locator.description: The SRv6 locator the instance's service SIDs come from (`segment-routing-srv6 locator`, see `segment_routing.srv6.locators`); null when it does not run over SRv6.

sr_policy_color.description: The SR policy color that steers the instance (`sr-policy color`); null when not configured.

VrfRouteTarget.title: VrfRouteTarget
VrfRouteTarget.description: A route target of a VRF (`bgp instance <as> vrf <name> route-target <id> direction ...`, or under a `vrf-address-family`). Since schema 1.7.

address_family.description: The VRF address family the target is set under (`ipv4 unicast`, `ipv6 unicast`); null when the VRF sets it for every address family.

VrfInstance.title: VrfInstance
VrfInstance.description: A SAOS 10 VRF: the `vrf` list entry (description, role, SRv6 and SR policy settings) merged with what BGP (`bgp instance <as> vrf <name>`) and MPLS label management say about it. Since schema 1.7.

role.description: `data` or `management` (a management VRF); null when not configured (the default is `data`).

bgp_as.description: The BGP instance (local AS) that carries the VRF (`bgp instance <as> vrf <name>`); null when BGP does not name the VRF.

route_distinguisher.description: The route distinguisher as written (`0:64500:1`); null when not configured.

address_families.description: The VRF address families BGP runs, `<afi> <safi>` (`ipv4 unicast`, `ipv6 unicast`), in configuration order.

route_targets.description: Route targets: those with a null `address_family` apply to every address family of the VRF.

srv6_locators.description: Per VRF address family, the SRv6 locator its L3 service SIDs (End.DT4 / End.DT6) come from: the address family's own (`vrf-address-family <afi> <safi> segment-routing-srv6 locator`), else the BGP instance's `vpnv4 unicast` / `vpnv6 unicast` locator, else the instance's locator. Empty when the VRF does not run over SRv6 (an L3VPN over MPLS / SR-MPLS, a VRF-Lite or management VRF).

srv6_locator_address.description: The SRv6 locator address the VRF itself sets (`vrf <name> segment-routing-srv6 locator <ipv6>`); null when not configured.

srv6_sid_type.description: The SID type that goes with `srv6_locator_address`: `u-sid` or `uncompressed-sid`; null when not configured.

sr_policy_color.description: The SR policy color that steers the VRF's traffic (`vrf <name> sr-policy color`); null when not configured.

label_allocation.description: The VPN label allocation mode per address family type (`mpls label-management allocation-mode vrf <name> address-family ipv4|ipv6 mode per-vrf|per-prefix`), by `ipv4` / `ipv6`: an L3VPN over MPLS or SR-MPLS. Empty when not configured.

redistribute.description: Per VRF address family, the protocols BGP redistributes into the VRF (`connected`, `static`, `isis`, `ospf`, ...); address families without any are left out.

interfaces.description: The interfaces bound to the VRF (`interfaces[].vrf`), in interface order.

StaticRoute.title: StaticRoute
StaticRoute.description: A SAOS 10 static route through one next hop (`rib vrf <name> ipv4|ipv6 <prefix> next-hop <address>` or `outgoing-interface <name>`). Since schema 1.7.

vrf.description: The VRF of the route (see `vrf_instances`); `default` for the global table.

next_hop.description: The next-hop address (or `blackhole`); null for a route through an outgoing interface alone.

interface.description: The outgoing interface (`outgoing-interface-name` of a next hop, or the `outgoing-interface` of the route; `Null0` discards); null when not configured.

preference.description: The route preference (administrative distance, 1-255) as written; null when not configured.

tag.description: The route tag; null when not configured.
